name: Leather Patch Flat Bill Snapback Hat
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from breathable mesh fabric and khaki cotton fabric, offering a comfortable, durable, and stylish everyday wear experience.
    - Features a classic flat bill snapback hat design with a structured front and ventilated mesh back for a bold and modern look.
    - The front panel is designed to hold a PU leather patch, creating a premium personalized accent.
    - Built with a soft sweatband to help keep the wearer dry and cool during daily use.
    - Adjustable snapback closure provides a flexible fit for most adults and teens.
    - Combines everyday comfort, breathable performance, and personalized streetwear style in one fashionable cap.
    - Cap color options: Red - White, Full White, Black - White, Grey, Pink - White, Navy, Blue - White, Full Black, Full Pink, White - Black.
    - Leather patch color options: M1, M2, M3, M4.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Hat sizing: 57–58 cm ~ 22.44–22.83 in
    - Leather patch size: 5.51 x 2.76 in ~ 14 x 7 cm
    📌 Note: The dimensions of the leather patch may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses advanced UV printing technology on the leather patch for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as a stylish everyday hat and personalized fashion accessory.
    - Designed to provide shade, breathability, and comfort for outdoor activities and casual daily wear.
    - The mesh back helps improve airflow, while the sweatband helps keep the wearer cool and dry.
    - Adjustable snapback closure allows a flexible fit for most adults and teens.
    - Perfect for travel, outdoor wear, sports, casual outfits, brand promotion, and everyday styling.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for family members, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, Father’s Day, holidays, anniversaries, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for streetwear lovers, hat collectors, sports fans, business branding, and custom team wear.
    - A thoughtful gift for anyone who enjoys personalized caps and casual fashion accessories.
    - Great for everyday wear, promotional events, club merchandise, and custom keepsakes.
    - Adds a trendy, personal, and practical touch to any outfit🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xLeather Patch Flat Bill Snapback Hat

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
